name: Lyman Pell
want: lay out a town that lasts, and come out of it rich
secret: He has staked the real depot ground under a false name, a mile from where the plat on his wall says it will be.
voice: Eastern, precise, too fond of the word "obviously".
description: A Rensselaer graduate who surveys ahead of the track and decides where towns will be.
appearance: Thin, clean-shaven, a good hat, ink-stained fingers, a transit always nearby.
